name: @ Coffee Café
address: Shop z2, 09 51 Main Rd, Knysna Central, Knysna, 6570, South Africa
description_short: Central Knysna coffee spot serving hearty breakfasts and quality coffee in a relaxed atmosphere.
description_long:
Tucked into Knysna Central on Main Road, @ Coffee Café has become a reliable morning stop for locals and visitors alike. The atmosphere is unpretentious and welcoming, with a menu that covers breakfast classics done well — think proper eggs Benedict, wholesome farm-style breakfasts, and freshly baked pastries alongside consistently good coffee.

The café's location makes it an easy pause before exploring Knysna's waterfront or heading out to the Heads. Service is friendly without fuss, and the space works equally well for a quick solo coffee or a leisurely breakfast catch-up. It's the kind of neighbourhood spot that does the basics right, with decent portions at fair prices and a steady stream of regulars who know what to expect.
